replies.author: MLGtino
replies.body:
We don't need a sub-forum, but they shouldn't be illegal.

The developers are showing 0 creativity in solving this issue. Banning them is a STUPID idea. That was the worst way of handling leaving post spam/attention whore posts. 

It could be as easy as putting a little tab extra tab on your profile that you can select (or not) either saying "This account is active", "This account is inactive", etc. And maybe if a player has accumulated more than 10 hours if playtime over a weekly period, it will automatically go to "this account is active", and if a player hasn't logged in for over 7 days, it will go back to "this account is inactive". Perhaps we can also add a little description box underneath allowing the player to explain their inactivity. Ex: "I'm on vacation in France :D", "Quit MC", "School", etc.

If this doesnt get much response I'll just make another thread.

replies.author: DonaldMyTrump
replies.body:
Solution: Make temp/maybe leaving posts illegal as these really shouldn't be posted imo. Also when a player says they are leaving for good don't remove the post just ban the player to help them quit. This sounds harsh but really isn't as the player is leaving anyways and it is still appeal-able. This way would discourage players from making these topics and then returning a week later while still allowing them to say good bye.

Also I like the idea of threads not showing up in recent discussions however I wouldn't limit it just to leaving threads
